title: Partners
description: We established several key strategic partnerships with universities and businesses in order to offer students the best leaning opportunities.

blocks.html:
USI is a small university with big ambitions, and in order to achieve them, it has established several key strategic partnerships.

Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne

Academic Partner

With eight hundred years of excellence to build on, the Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, a descendant of the Faculty of Law and Economics of the Sorbonne, is one of the most famous and largest universities in France. Some forty thousand students are enrolled on 14 teaching and research departments (Unités de Formation et de Recherche) and 5 Institutes, which offer top-level degree courses in law, political science, economics, management and the humanities. The university is principally located in the heart of the Latin Quarter, and occupies part of the Sorbonne and other prestigious French university buildings. The Master in Science in Digital Fashion Communication is being offered as a Double Degree with Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne.

ISEM Fashion Business School (University of Navarra)

Academic Collaboration

The ISEM Fashion Business School, a centre of the University of Navarra, is the first Spanish business school specialized in fashion businesses, founded in 2001. Founded by Covadonga O’Shea, the new business school was born with the objective of teaching professionals negotiation and leadership skills in order to enable them to work more effectively in the fashion industry. Its vocation is the professionalization of the sector and to be a centre of convergence between management and creativity.

The Lifestyle Tech Competence Center

The Lifestyle Tech Competence Center is a research and development center based in Switzerland that promotes innovation in the lifestyle area. The Master in Science in Digital Fashion Communication has been in constant contact with the centre and all its members for the guest speakers coming from the fashion industry, consultancy project activities, organisation of the study tours and public events.
